sbar.situation: The bank payment journey has recovered. Two checks in a row came back clean, the last at 27 s.
sbar.background: Pipeline config changed payments max_transfer_minor from 1000000 to 1, so every payment was rejected with 422. Ops-maintenance raised gateway balance_cache_ttl_s from 0.5 to 600 s, and the screening primary process exited with code 15.
sbar.assessment: The incident commander took every action itself. It failed screening over to screening-standby and restarted the screening primary, both done. It reverted payments max_transfer_minor to 1000000 and gateway balance_cache_ttl_s to 0.5, both done.
sbar.recommendation: Find out why pipeline set max_transfer_minor to 1 and why ops-maintenance set the 600 s cache TTL, and stop both from happening again. Find out why screening exited with code 15, then decide whether to move traffic back from screening-standby to the restarted primary. Operations should review the payments rejected with 422 while the limit was 1, so customers can retry them.
